_meta.source: CUI Wah Campus Academic Regulations & Student Handbook

attendance_policy.title: Attendance Policy
attendance_policy.debar_threshold: Below 60% attendance results in debarment from final exams
rules: A student must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each enrolled course to be eligible to sit in the final examination.
If attendance falls below 60%, the student is automatically debarred from final exams in that course.
Between 60%–74%, the department may grant conditional permission at the HOD's discretion.
Medical exemptions require a certificate from a registered physician and must be submitted to the HOD within one week.
Online attendance records are accessible via the student portal.

academic_integrity.title: Academic Integrity & Plagiarism Policy
rules: Plagiarism in any form (copying assignments, submitting AI-generated work without disclosure, cheating in exams) is strictly prohibited.
First offense: Failing grade in the assignment/exam.
Second offense: Failing grade in the course.
Third offense: Suspension or expulsion from the university.
Turnitin similarity threshold for theses and dissertations is 19% overall.
All course assignments may be checked using plagiarism detection software.

exam_policy.title: Examination Policy
rules: Mid-term exams are typically held in the 8th week and final exams at the end of the semester.
A student must present their student ID card to enter the examination hall.
Use of mobile phones or any electronic device (other than a permitted calculator) in the exam hall is strictly prohibited.
A student arriving more than 30 minutes late may be denied entry.
Final exam schedule is published on the CUI student portal at least 2 weeks in advance.
Make-up exams are only granted for genuine medical emergencies with documented proof.

code_of_conduct.title: Student Code of Conduct
rules: Students must maintain a respectful, professional demeanor on campus at all times.
Dress code must be adhered to: formal/semi-formal attire. Casual wear (ripped jeans, shorts, sleeveless) is not allowed.
Smoking is strictly prohibited inside all university buildings and classrooms.
Students must carry their ID cards at all times when on campus.
Any form of ragging, harassment, or bullying is a zero-tolerance offense and may result in immediate expulsion.
Political or religious gatherings are not permitted on campus without prior written approval from the administration.
Students must not use university equipment or resources for personal or commercial activities.

degree_completion.title: Degree Completion Requirements
bs_requirements: Complete all required credit hours (typically 130–136 credit hours for BS programs).
Maintain a minimum CGPA of 2.0 out of 4.0.
Complete Final Year Project (FYP) with a passing grade.
Clear all dues and submit clearance form to the Registrar's Office.
ms_requirements: Complete all required coursework (typically 30 credit hours).
Maintain a minimum CGPA of 2.5 out of 4.0.
Successfully defend MS Thesis (for thesis track) or complete research project (for non-thesis).
Clear all dues and submit clearance.

transfer_policy.title: Credit Transfer Policy
rules: CUI does NOT accept credit hour transfers from any national or international institution.
However, a CUI student may transfer their credits to other universities, subject to the policies of the receiving institution.
Campus transfer within CUI (e.g., from Islamabad to Wah) is possible within the same session upon mutual agreement between campuses.

hostel_rules.title: Hostel Rules & Regulations
rules: Hostel gate closes at 10:00 PM. Late entry requires prior written permission from the Warden.
Visitors are not allowed inside hostel rooms. Meeting area is provided in the common area.
Cooking in rooms is strictly prohibited.
Students are responsible for the cleanliness of their rooms.
Any damage to hostel property will be charged to the student.
Hostel mess provides 3 meals per day (included in the Rs. 55,000 hostel fee).
Hostel allocation is on first come first served basis and may be revoked for disciplinary reasons.
